properties.description: Detects successful Azure diagnostic settings writes or deletions. Changes can reduce logging visibility; legitimate policy remediation and administration can also match. Initial deployment stays disabled and creates no incidents.
properties.query:
AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated between (ago(1h) .. now())
| where OperationNameValue in~ ("Microsoft.Insights/diagnosticSettings/write", "Microsoft.Insights/diagnosticSettings/delete")
| where ActivityStatusValue in~ ("Success", "Succeeded")
| extend TargetResourceId = coalesce(ResourceId, _ResourceId)
| extend SourceIPAddress = iff(CallerIpAddress !contains "/" and isnotempty(parse_ipv6(CallerIpAddress)), CallerIpAddress, "")
| project TimeGenerated, OperationNameValue, ActivityStatusValue, Caller, SourceIPAddress, TargetResourceId, ResourceGroup, CorrelationId, EventDataId
| distinct *
